decision: Gated cache_fresh skips only the live drift probe via an explicit --work-selection / --skip-drift-probe argv seam; never via missing --for-issue and never via deferred_reason

governingRule.description: Do not auto-defer gated readiness steps; deferred_reason is treated as satisfied. --for-issue cannot be the gated discriminator because GATED_ENTRYPOINT_COMMANDS used a constant argv.

alternativesConsidered.option: Default the gated argv to --for-issue-less soft skip of cache_fresh
alternativesConsidered.whyNot: Blanket fail-soft already declined on #3500; ceremony-dial forbids auto-defer of gated steps

alternativesConsidered.option: Skip drift whenever --for-issue is absent on the constant argv
alternativesConsidered.whyNot: Absence of --for-issue is unconditionally true at the gated boundary and carries zero information (Scott comment on #3507)

alternativesConsidered.option: Record the skip as deferred_reason on the cache_fresh step
alternativesConsidered.whyNot: stepPasses treats deferred_reason as satisfied, so the gated loop would skip the age check too

whyWinner: Plumb a real work-selection detector (active story xBRIEF / scope:activate residue, unexhausted plan-sequence including triage kind, or an injectable seam) and thread an explicit flag through the gated argv. evaluate skips the live drift probe only when skipDriftProbe is set and --for-issue is not present. Ritual state records drift_probe skipped-no-work-selection as a distinct top-level field so stepPasses cannot treat it as a pass. The probe re-arms when work selection appears. Age staleness stays hard. This sits inside #1149: the doctrine is work selection; a non-selection path was never in scope for the drift probe.
revisitTrigger: If triage:queue gains a durable pick residue besides active xBRIEF and plan-sequence, fold that source into detectWorkSelection. Revisit if #3214 ceremony-dial starts treating any non-deferred_reason field as a satisfied gated step.
